question: Who among the following unveiled a statue of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in Pune, Maharashtra, in March 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** inaugurated a towering statue of the revered **Maratha warrior, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj**, in Pune, Maharashtra.
 
• Crafted from** 1,850 kg of gunmetal, **the statue stands at an impressive height of 9.5 feet.
 
• He inaugurated a 12-kilometer segment of the 32.2-kilometer-long metro rail project, with a total investment exceeding ₹11,400 crores.
 
• The Pune Metro project is notable for being the first in India to feature aluminium body coaches, produced domestically as part of the** 'Make in India' **initiative.
 
• Prime Minister Modi laid the foundation stone for the rejuvenation and pollution abatement of the Mula-Mutha River projects in Pune.
 
• This initiative aims to revitalize a 9-kilometer stretch of the river, with an estimated cost exceeding Rs 1080 crore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Shivaji I,** an Indian ruler and a member of the **Bhonsle Maratha clan**, established his own independent kingdom by seizing territory from the declining Adilshahi Sultanate of Bijapur, laying the foundation for the Maratha Empire.
 
• In 1674, he was officially crowned the Chhatrapati of his realm at Raigad Fort.
 
• Shivaji navigated a complex landscape of alliances and conflicts with the Mughal Empire, the Sultanate of Golkonda, the Sultanate of Bijapur, and various European colonial powers.
 
• His military campaigns expanded the Maratha sphere of influence through the capture and construction of forts, as well as the establishment of a Maratha navy.
